statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated Security Officer and Privacy Officer in writing
Annual risk analysis using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with periodic outside review
Annual policy review
Sanctions for any future workforce
Written, time-limited exceptions
No BAA, no PHI
Annual review of the EHR vendor SOC 2 report and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Unique accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every PHI service that offers it
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Written account approval; same-day removal; quarterly user review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly review of EHR audit log and email sign-in history
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems with a BAA
Full-disk encryption on every device
No PHI by ordinary text message
Clinical photos into the EHR the same day
File versioning in the business file plan
Shredding bin; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Six-year retention of security documentation
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Practice network or hotspot, not the shared building network
AI tools only after assessment, BAA, and approval; all-party recording consent
Annual security training for the owner
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Coverage arrangement with a nearby physician
